simple.summary: אַמְצָה (ʼamtsâh) means force First listed occurrence: Zech 12 5.

definitions.full: H556. amtsah אַמְצָה noun feminine strength , figurative Zech 12:5 , but sense difficult, compare Wr Zech. P. 585 ; Sta ZAW 1881, 34 proposes אָמְצְאָה לְיוֺשְׁבֵי (after ᵑ7 ᵐ5 ) may I be sufficient for.
